items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯技术总监詹姆斯·艾利森警告，F1工程师将对国际汽联2027年削减下压力的计划予以反击。国际汽联正推动在2027年再次强制降低下压力，有早期报道称目标削减幅度为20至50点下压力。

items.summaryEn: Mercedes technical director James Allison has warned that F1 engineers will fight back against the FIA's planned 2027 downforce cuts. The governing body is pushing to mandate another drop in downforce for 2027, with early reports indicating a target reduction of 20 to 50 points of downforce.
detailZh: 梅赛德斯技术总监警告，F1车队不会对2027年下压力削减坐视不管
梅赛德斯技术总监詹姆斯·艾利森警告，F1工程师将对国际汽联2027年的下压力削减予以反击
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
F1向2026年新动力单元与底盘规则的过渡彻底打乱了竞争格局，但规则手册远未最终确定。随着车队为2027年新规下的第二个赛季做准备，国际汽联正推动再次强制降低下压力。
早期报告表明，管理机构的目标是在2027赛季将下压力减少20至50个点。为了实现这一目标，国际汽联计划禁止若干关键的后部空气动力学部件，以改善混合动力能量管理，并减少阻碍赛车紧密跟车的湍流“脏空气”。
但梅赛德斯技术总监詹姆斯·艾利森最近警告说，制定规则来减慢一级方程式赛车的速度，很少能阻止围场顶尖工程师找到绕过它的办法。
在NU Silver Arrows Radio Show播客节目中，艾利森确认了国际汽联拟议的空气动力学限制范围，同时向即将到来的研发战发出了挑战。
“我所知道的是，新规则会让赛车损失一些下压力，不止一点，”艾利森解释道。
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯车队；安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯车队
从历史上看，国际汽联与一级方程式车队之间的关系始终是一场无休止的猫鼠游戏。管理机构出于安全和竞赛考量修改规则手册以限制过弯速度，而车队则立即在风洞中投入数百万美元，以恢复国际汽联试图削去的下压力。
据艾利森表示，2027年的规则周期也不会有任何不同。
“他们已经做出了不错的尝试，试图将下压力拉回到2026时代初期的水平，”艾利森指出。
他补充道：“看看各车队是会选择妥协接受，还是会全力夺回全部性能，这将非常有意思。”
如果梅赛德斯在2026年的巨大飞跃能说明什么，那就是阿利森在布拉克利的工程部门完全没有妥协的打算。2027赛季的技术战线已经正式划定。
detailEn: Mercedes technical director warns F1 teams won’t “lie down” over 2027 downforce cuts
Mercedes technical director James Allison warns F1 engineers will fight back against the FIA's 2027 downforce cuts
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

Formula 1's transition to the new 2026 engine and chassis regulations completely reshuffled the competitive order, but the rulebook is far from finalised. As teams prepare for their second year under the new formula in 2027, the FIA is pushing to mandate another drop in downforce.

Early reports indicate the governing body is targeting a reduction of 20 to 50 points of downforce for the 2027 season. To achieve this, the FIA plans to ban several key rear aerodynamic elements in a bid to improve hybrid energy management and reduce the turbulent "dirty air" that prevents cars from following each other closely.
But Mercedes technical director James Allison recently cautioned that writing a rule to slow down a Formula 1 car rarely stops the grid's top engineers from finding a way around it.

Speaking on the NU Silver Arrows Radio Show podcast, Allison confirmed the scope of the FIA's proposed aerodynamic restrictions while simultaneously throwing down the gauntlet for the upcoming development war.
"All I know is that the cars are going to be losing a bit of downforce from the new regs, more than a bit," Allison explained.
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes

Historically, the relationship between the FIA and Formula 1 constructors is a perpetual game of cat and mouse. The governing body alters the rulebook to limit cornering speeds on safety and racing grounds, and the teams immediately spend millions of dollars in the wind tunnel to recover the exact downforce the FIA attempted to take away.
According to Allison, the 2027 regulation cycle will be no different.
"They've had a good go at trying to pull the downforce back to [the] start of the 2026 era," Allison noted.
"It'll be interesting to see whether the teams lie down and take that or whether we recover it all or not," he added.

If Mercedes' massive leap forward in 2026 is any indication, Allison's engineering department in Brackley has zero intention of lying down. The technical battle lines for the 2027 season have officially been drawn.

detailZh: 梅赛德斯-奔驰和奥迪在F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛上推出阿迪达斯系列
梅赛德斯-奔驰霓虹灯和奥迪夜场系列现已通过adidas.com购买
拉斯维加斯欢迎标志上空出现彩虹
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
梅赛德斯-奔驰和奥迪为即将到来的Formula 1拉斯维加斯大奖赛推出了特别的阿迪达斯粉丝系列。
梅赛德斯-奔驰的系列名为"霓虹灯"，而奥迪的系列名为"深夜"。这两个系列现在已在adidas.com上上市，品牌美国店内的单品价格从30美元到200美元不等。
最贵的产品是外套。梅赛德斯-奔驰的拉斯维加斯夹克和奥迪的拉斯维加斯轰炸机夹克都售价200美元。
梅赛德斯-奔驰的系列比奥迪的大。除了夹克，它还包括120美元的卫衣、95美元的长袖T恤、60美元的短裤、55美元的车手帽、50美元的比赛帽和40美元及45美元的T恤。
奥迪车队的阵容有55美元的车手上限，两件各45美元的图形T恤和一件30美元的包。
两支车队抵达拉斯维加斯时的位置截然不同。梅赛德斯在巴西大奖赛上锁定了2026年 constructors' championship。奥迪在接管萨博后作为一支工厂车队的第一赛季，目前排名第八，积28分。这家德国车队落后哈斯三分。
梅赛德斯车队的基米·安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛中赢得了车手冠军，成为F1历史上最年轻的冠军。他的队友乔治·拉塞尔目前正在争夺亚军，目前排名第三，落后红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘。
奥迪的加布里埃尔·博尔特洛托和尼科·胡肯伯格目前在车手积分榜上分别排名第14和第15，两人都积14分。
拉斯维加斯大奖赛将于11月19日至21日举行，是赛季最后三轮比赛中的第一轮，紧接着是卡塔尔和阿布扎比。
detailEn: Mercedes and Audi unveil adidas collections for F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix
The Mercedes Neon Lights and Audi After Hours collections are available now through adidas.com
A rainbow above the Welcome to Las Vegas sign
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Mercedes and Audi have unveiled special adidas fan collections for the upcoming Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix.

Mercedes' range is called "Neon Lights", while Audi's is named "After Hours". Both collections are available now through adidas.com, and the pieces listed on the brand's US store range in price from $30 to $200.
The most expensive items are the outerwear. Mercedes' Las Vegas jacket and Audi's Las Vegas bomber jacket both cost $200.
The Mercedes collection is the bigger of the two. Alongside the jacket, it includes a $120 hoodie, a $95 long-sleeve T-shirt, $60 shorts, a $55 driver cap, a $50 race cap and T-shirts at $40 and $45.
Audi's line-up has a $55 driver cap, two graphic T-shirts at $45 each and a $30 bag.

The two teams arrive in Las Vegas in very different positions. Mercedes secured the 2026 constructors' championship at the Brazilian Grand Prix. Audi, in its first season as a works team after taking over Sauber, currently sits eighth in the standings with 28 points. The German outfit is three points behind Haas.

Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli claimed the drivers' title at the Mexican Grand Prix, becoming the youngest champion in the history of F1. His team-mate George Russell is currently in the fight for second in the championship, sitting third behind Red Bull's Max Verstappen.
Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto and Nico Hulkenberg currently sit 14th and 15th in the drivers' standings, both on 14 points.
The Las Vegas Grand Prix takes place from 19 to 21 November and is the first of the final three rounds of the season, ahead of Qatar and Abu Dhabi.

items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen signs ambassador deal with Dutch technical group VDK
items.summaryEn: Four-time Formula 1 world champion Max Verstappen has become the new ambassador of the VDK Group, a Dutch group of installation and technical companies, and will feature in its communications and marketing campaigns over the coming years.
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘与荷兰技术集团VDK签任大使协议
这位红牛车手将在未来数年参与VDK的传播与营销活动
致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术洞察与比赛分析。
四届F1世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘成为荷兰安装与技术企业集团VDK Group的新任大使，该集团正在向欧洲扩张。
这位荷兰车手将在未来几年在该公司的国际品牌推广中发挥重要作用，并将出现在其传播和营销活动中。
VDK 成立于 2013 年，是一家荷兰技术公司集团，如今在荷兰、德国、瑞典、奥地利、瑞士和比利时都有业务。
维斯塔潘表示，他认为 VDK 的组织方式与 F1 车队的运作方式有相似之处。
“VDK 的世界与一级方程式赛车之间有很多相似之处，”这位红牛车手说道。“技术发挥着巨大作用，但任何关注这项运动的人都知道，只有整个团队都达到顶尖水平，你才能发挥出最佳表现。”
在一支一级方程式车队里，每天都有大量的人在工作，让一切变得更好、更快。每个人都有自己的专业领域和职责。我在VDK的运作方式中看到了这一点。
它由许多技术公司和专业人士组成，他们各有专长，但团结在一起就更强大。VDK是一家创新型公司，也有着远大的国际雄心。我很高兴能在未来几年成为其中一员。
VDK创始人兼首席执行官弗兰斯·范德科尔克表示，这位荷兰人是公司下一步发展的理想人选。
“马克斯·维斯塔潘加入VDK集团让我无比自豪，”范德科尔克说。“马克斯多年来一直是世界上最顶尖的车手之一。但同样吸引我的是这背后的一切。仅靠天赋永远不够。你需要身边有优秀的人、相互信任、技术专长，以及每天变得更好的动力。这正是我在VDK集团所看到的。”
“我们通过整合实力雄厚的本地家族企业，并给予创业者自由发展的空间来实现增长。这一基础不会改变。与此同时，我们正日益将目光投向国门之外。”
“随着在荷兰、德国、瑞典、奥地利、瑞士和比利时拥有公司，我们正在形成一个日益国际化的集团。马克斯·维斯塔潘闻名世界，同时也体现了那种令人熟悉的荷兰务实态度和赢家心态。说实话，我无法想象还有谁比他更能代表我们希望带领VDK前进的方向。”
过去两年一直与VDK合作的前F1车手罗伯特·杜恩博斯将继续担任大使和演讲嘉宾。根据公告，他在协调与维斯塔潘的合作关系中发挥了关键作用。
“我非常高兴能与弗兰斯和VDK集团合作，”杜恩博斯解释道。“我们已经共同取得了伟大的成就，我也真正了解了VDK背后的人。如今我还能为这一下一步贡献力量，这让一切更加特别。”
“有了马克斯，VDK 集团当然就引进了一位真正独一档的人物。我很高兴我们现在为 VDK 集团携手合作，也非常期待未来的岁月。”
detailEn: Max Verstappen signs ambassador deal with Dutch technical group VDK
The Red Bull driver will feature in VDK’s communications and marketing campaigns over the coming years
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen has become the new ambassador of the VDK Group, a Dutch group of installation and technical companies that is expanding across Europe.
The Dutchman will play a prominent role in the company's international branding over the coming years and will feature in its communications and marketing campaigns.
VDK was founded in 2013 as a Dutch group of technical companies and now has businesses in the Netherlands, Germany, Sweden, Austria, Switzerland and Belgium.
Verstappen said he saw parallels between the way VDK is organised and the way an F1 team works.

"There are many similarities between the world of VDK and Formula 1," the Red Bull driver said. "Technology plays a huge role, but anyone who follows the sport knows that you can only perform at your best if the entire team is top-notch.

"In a Formula 1 team, a huge number of people work every day to make everything better and faster. Everyone has their own area of specialisation and responsibility. I recognise that in the way VDK operates.

"It’s a group of many technical companies and professionals who all have their own expertise but are stronger together. VDK is an innovative company and also has major international ambitions. I’m excited to be a part of that in the coming years."
VDK founder and chief executive Frans van der Kolk said the Dutchman was the ideal fit for the company's next step.

"The fact that Max Verstappen is joining the VDK Group makes me incredibly proud," van der Kolk said. "Max has been among the absolute world’s best for years. But what appeals to me just as much is what lies behind that. Talent alone is never enough. You need good people around you, mutual trust, technical expertise, and the drive to get better every day. That’s exactly what I see in the VDK Group.

"We’ve grown by bringing together strong local and family-owned businesses and giving entrepreneurs the freedom to thrive. That foundation won’t change. At the same time, we’re looking beyond our borders with increasing focus.

"With companies in the Netherlands, Germany, Sweden, Austria, Switzerland, and Belgium, we’re forming an increasingly international group. Max Verstappen is known worldwide and, at the same time, embodies that recognisable Dutch down-to-earth attitude and winner’s mentality. To be honest, I can’t imagine a stronger face to represent where we want to take VDK."

Former F1 driver Robert Doornbos, who has worked with VDK for the past two years, will stay on as an ambassador and speaker. According to the announcement, he played a key role in coordinating the partnership with Verstappen.

"I am very pleased with the collaboration with Frans and the VDK Group," Doornbos explained. "We’ve already achieved great things together, and I’ve really gotten to know the people behind VDK. The fact that I’ve now also been able to contribute to this next step makes it even more special.

"With Max, the VDK Group is, of course, bringing in someone who is truly in a league of his own. I’m happy that we’re now working together for the VDK Group and am really looking forward to the years ahead."

items.summaryZh: 新科F1世界冠军安东内利会见意大利总统马塔雷拉，庆祝他在墨西哥大奖赛赢得世界冠军，结束意大利车手自1953年以来的世界冠军荒。

items.originalTitle: Kimi Antonelli meets Italian president Sergio Mattarella
detailZh: 基米·安东内利会见了意大利总统塞尔吉奥·马塔雷拉
这位新的F1世界冠军受到了意大利总统的接待，向塞尔吉奥·马塔雷拉总统赠送了一顶头盔，头盔的护目镜上写着致词
“致马塔雷拉总统，怀着崇高的敬意，”基米·安东内利签名道。
新的F1世界冠军正处于一场风暴之中，这是他两周前在墨西哥大奖赛上赢得的世界冠军，这场胜利结束了自1953年以来意大利车手赢得世界冠军的干旱局面。
安东内利，和他的父母Marco和Veronica以及他的妹妹Maggie一起，于周五受到了意大利共和国总统Sergio Mattarella的接见。
会面在罗马的奎里纳莱宫举行，安东内利向总统赠送了他的一顶带有题词的官方头盔。
安东内利与意大利国家最高领导人进行了交谈，向他解释了在比赛中佩戴头盔的感受，以及驾驶一级方程式赛车从身体角度所需要承受的挑战。
"你大概会失去两公斤体重，"他说。"我们穿着防火服，这也非常热。我们训练以尽可能做好准备，并能够承受驾驶时感受到的热量。但然后在训练结束后，你会跳进一个装满冷水的浴缸中..."
总统问道：“那么在二级方程式赛车和卡丁车比赛中也是这样吗？”
安东内利回答道：“在卡丁车中稍微少一些。你更暴露在外。在单座赛车中，你是封闭的。但在二级方程式赛车中，比赛时间稍短，也更不激烈。一级方程式赛车的比赛平均持续一个半小时。但明年你会来看一些比赛吗？也许在蒙扎？有你和我们一起真是太好了。”
马塔雷拉微笑着回答：“我真的希望如此。现在一级方程式赛车对我有很大的吸引力！上次还是几年前。总是很复杂，因为我的活动很复杂……但这个新的情况[指安东内利的竞争力]极大地鼓舞了我。”
与总统的会面只是安东内利众多活动中的最新一次。几个小时前，安东内利观看了意大利男子国家队与法国队的比赛，意大利以3-1获胜，而前一天他在他目前居住的圣马力诺停留，以庆祝世界冠军。
安东内利将飞回美国，这次前往内华达州，参加2026年一级方程式赛季倒数第三轮比赛，地点在拉斯维加斯。

detailEn: Kimi Antonelli meets Italian president Sergio Mattarella
The new Formula 1 world champion was received by the president of the Italy, presenting Sergio Mattarella with one of his helmets bearing a dedication written on the visor
"To President Mattarella, with great admiration," signed Kimi Antonelli.

The new Formula 1 world champion is in the middle of a whirlwind of meetings, events and celebrations for the world title he won two weeks ago at the Mexico Grand Prix, with which he ended a title drought for an Italian driver to win the world championship dating back to 1953.
Antonelli, together with his parents Marco and Veronica and his sister Maggie, was received on Friday by the president of the Italian Republic, Sergio Mattarella.
The meeting took place at the Quirinale in Rome, with Antonelli giving the president one of his official helmets with a dedication written on the visor.

Antonelli spoke with the highest office of the Italian state, explaining to him the sensations of wearing a helmet during a race, but also what driving a Formula 1 single-seater entails from a physical point of view.

"You lose roughly a couple of kilograms," he said. "We have the fireproof suit, which is also hot. We train to be as ready as we can and to be able to withstand the heat we experience when we drive. But then after the session you jump into a tub of cold water..."
The president then asked: "But was it like that in Formula 2 as well? And in karts?"

"In karts a little less so," Antonelli replied. "You are much more out in the open. In a single-seater you are enclosed. But in F2 the races last a little less and are less physical. In Formula 1 the race lasts an average of an hour and a half. But will you come and see some races next year? Maybe at Monza? It would be very nice to have you with us."

Mattarella, with a smile, replied: "I really hope so. Now Formula 1 attracts me a lot! The last time was several years ago. It is always complicated, because my movements are complex... But this new situation [referring to Antonelli's competitiveness] greatly encourages me."

The meeting with the president was only the latest of Antonelli's engagements. A few hours earlier, Antonelli had attended the match between the Italian men's national football team and the French side, which Italy won 3-1, while the previous day he had stopped in San Marino - where he currently lives - to celebrate the world title.
Antonelli will fly back to the United States, this time to Nevada, to contest the third-to-last round of the 2026 Formula 1 season in Las Vegas.

detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔表示正在面临基米·安东内利的强大速度，詹姆斯·阿隆索如是说
詹姆斯·阿隆索赞扬乔治·拉塞尔的诚实，面对基米·安东内利的驾驶优势，英国车手直面自己的驾驶不足
对于梅赛德斯车迷来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括来自布拉克利和布里克斯顿的F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析
对于一位资深的F1车手来说，被20岁的队友击败有时会导致维修区政治和借口。对于乔治·拉塞尔来说，2026赛季正是这样一场高压场景，基米·安东内利在姐妹车W17上勇夺世界冠军。
然而，在经历了机械故障和驾驶错误而备受破坏的一个赛季之后，而不是推卸责任，拉塞尔直面了安东内利原始速度的现实。
在Nu Silver Arrows广播节目中发表讲话，梅赛德斯技术总监詹姆斯·阿利森透露了布拉克利车队内部的动态，赞扬了拉塞尔在失败面前的残酷自我意识。
“他从不掩饰自己的不足。他是我有幸共事过的最诚实车手之一，”阿利森透露。“他可以看到基米今年在某些方面比他更快，他知道这些都是他需要带到桌面上来与这位早熟年轻天才平等或更好竞争的东西。”
安东内利的驾驶风格——特别是他在弯道中极端使用刹车迁移调整——使这位意大利人能够保持他的后胎，并在各节练习与排位中后期提取出惊人的速度。拉塞尔的传统优势在于在弯道出口使用更传统、更具侵略性的油门应用，但在几个轮胎磨损的场景中，他发现自己落后了。
但是，根据阿隆索的说法，拉塞尔愿意承认这一具体技术差距正是他成为冠军级车手的原因。
"我非常钦佩他直面这一问题的态度，" 阿隆索解释道。"[我们]将会看到他努力构建一个平台，这将使他能够在下一年与一位极具天赋的队友并肩作战。",
随着2026年 车队对梅赛德斯的成功锁定，拉塞尔的焦点已经完全转向调整他的设置参数，以匹配安东内利为即将到来的2027赛季设定的基准。
detailEn: George Russell is “looking down the barrel” of Kimi Antonelli’s raw pace, says James Allison
James Allison praises George Russell's honesty as the Briton confronts his own driving deficiencies against Kimi Antonelli
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

For an established Formula 1 driver, being beaten by a 20-year-old team-mate can sometimes lead to garage politics and excuses. For George Russell, the 2026 season delivered exactly that high-pressure scenario as Kimi Antonelli stormed to the world championship in the sister Mercedes W17.
But rather than deflecting blame after a season marred by mechanical misfortune and driving errors, Russell is confronting the reality of Antonelli's raw speed head-on.

Speaking on the Nu Silver Arrows Radio Show, Mercedes technical director James Allison provided a glimpse into the intra-team dynamic at Brackley, praising Russell for his brutal self-awareness in the face of defeat.

"He does not hide from his own deficiencies. He's one of the most honest drivers I've ever had the good fortune to work with," Allison revealed. "He can see the areas where Kimi has been quicker than him this year, and he knows that those are things that he needs to bring to the table to compete on equal or better terms with this precocious young talent."

Antonelli's driving style - specifically his extreme use of mid-corner brake migration adjustments - allowed the Italian to preserve his rear tyres and extract blistering pace late in stints. Russell, whose strength traditionally lies in a more conventional, aggressive throttle application on corner exit, found himself outpaced in several tyre-degrading scenarios.
But, according to Allison, Russell's willingness to acknowledge that specific technical gap is exactly what makes him a championship-calibre driver.

"I do very much admire the fact that he looks straight down the barrel of that," Allison explained. "[We're] gonna see him looking to build the platform that is going to let him have a run at it next year alongside an amazingly talented team-mate."

With the 2026 constructors' championship successfully secured for Mercedes, Russell's focus has completely shifted toward evolving his set-up parameters to match Antonelli's benchmark for the upcoming 2027 season.

detailZh: 迈凯伦将在拉斯维加斯为MCL40带来升级
迈凯伦在拉斯维加斯从未取得成功，但即将到来的升级或许会有帮助——目光已投向2027年
迈凯伦将在F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛为MCL40引入升级，新部件被称为“明年赛车的基础”。
车队在巴西推出了2027年前翼概念，车队负责人安德烈亚·斯特拉将其描述为可驾驶性和可预测性的提升；迈凯伦在英特拉格斯重回正轨，兰多·诺里斯在湿地条件下夺得杆位和胜利。这终结了连续五轮无缘领奖台的走势，是车队自2023赛季前半段以来最差的一段表现。
“在匈牙利站升级之后，我们能够处于争胜的位置，这令人鼓舞——我们本应赢下马德里站的，真的，”斯特拉说道，他指的是西班牙站虚拟安全车出现的不幸时机，这很可能让诺里斯丢掉了在马德里赛道的胜利。
“但在那之后，其他人也带来了升级，我们失去了这个位置。我认为我们也为没有跑出出色的排位赛表现付出了代价。如果能看到兰多（诺里斯）在奥斯汀或墨西哥这样的比赛中从前方发车，那会很有意思；那绝对会是一场领奖台之争。
“但正是得益于这些升级，我们现在才有条件去争夺胜利，当然也要结合具体情况。而这些升级，首先，它们将在拉斯维加斯得到更多部件的补充。它们构成了明年赛车的基础。所以，对于迈凯伦的发展轨迹来说，这令人鼓舞，因为我们似乎能够将研发转化为赛道上的表现。”
拉斯维加斯对这支木瓜色车队来说并不是福地。早在2023年，迈凯伦已经成为稳定的领奖台争夺者，但两辆车都在第一节排位赛（Q1）中被淘汰；奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里只拿到一个积分，而兰多·诺里斯则在第三圈触底并严重撞车。
第二年，这位最终的车队冠军车手仅排位第六和第八，正赛中平淡地跑到第六和第七，落后前五名27秒。
上赛季，诺里斯确实拿到了杆位；他和皮亚斯特里在正赛中守住了第二和第四，而争冠对手马克斯·维斯塔潘获胜，但两辆车因MCL39最尾部的滑板块磨损过度而被取消资格。
基于MCL40的特性，斯特拉并不一定认为内华达赛道今年会利于迈凯伦，因为近2公里的长直道部分需要全油门。
“拉斯维加斯是非常不同的赛道布局，长直道，”这位意大利人评论道。“我们知道——我们在蒙扎见过，我们在巴库见过——当要求是提升极速时，迈凯伦不一定是最好的车。我们知道这也在某种程度上与我们[较短的]齿轮比有关，当你需要超过某个极速水平时，这些齿轮比并不理想。
“但话虽如此，我们带着一些乐观情绪前往维加斯，因为赛车现在更快了。这场比赛将让我们——我想不只是我们，而是所有人——对如何使用轮胎、赛车在哪些地方表现好、他们的赛车或我们的赛车在哪些地方稍逊一筹有一些了解。所以也有信息可以为维加斯所用。”
“所以我们带着一些乐观情绪看待。另外，维加斯，我们想去那里取得好成绩，因为在赛历上的所有比赛中，这可能是我们最挣扎的一站。即便去年我们有一场不错的比赛，我们也因为底板滑块的问题让自己的处境变得糟糕。我们期待维加斯，在那里取得好成绩，最终与这条赛道和平相处。”
detailEn: McLaren to upgrade MCL40 car at its bogey F1 track Las Vegas
McLaren has never been successful in Las Vegas, but upcoming updates might help – with eyes on 2027
McLaren will introduce upgrades to its MCL40 at Formula 1’s Las Vegas Grand Prix, with the new parts labelled as “the foundation for next year’s car”.

The team launched its 2027 front wing concept in Brazil, with team principal Andrea Stella describing it as an improvement for driveability and predictability; McLaren returned to form at Interlagos, with Lando Norris clinching pole position and victory in wet conditions. This ended a five-round podium-less streak, the squad’s worst since the first half of the 2023 campaign.

“After the upgrades in Hungary, it was encouraging that we were in a position to win – we should have won Madrid, really,” Stella said, referring to the unfortunate timing of the Virtual Safety Car in Spain, which likely cost Norris the victory at Madring.

“But after that, other people took upgrades and we lost this position. I think we also paid the price of not having had great qualifying sessions. It would have been interesting to see Lando starting from the front in races like Austin or Mexico; it would have been definitely a fight for podium.

“But it's thanks to these upgrades that we are now in condition to fight for the victory, combined with the conditions surely. And these upgrades, first of all, they will be complemented by some more parts that come in Vegas. And they form the foundation for what will be next year's car. So, it's encouraging for the trajectory of McLaren that we seem to be able to transform our development into performance on track.”

Las Vegas has not been a happy hunting ground for the papaya team. Back in 2023, McLaren had become a consistent podium contender, but both cars were out in Q1; Oscar Piastri scored a solitary point, while Lando Norris bottomed out and heavily crashed on lap three.
The following year, the eventual constructors’ champion qualified just sixth and eighth, uneventfully driving to sixth and seventh in the race, 27 seconds adrift of the top five.

Last season, Norris did take pole; he and Piastri held on to second and fourth in the race as title rival Max Verstappen prevailed, but both cars were disqualified due to the MCL39s’ rearmost skid blocks being too worn.
Based on the MCL40’s specificities, Stella doesn’t necessarily expect the Nevadan track to favour McLaren this year, with full throttle down the near-2km Strip portion.

“It's a very different circuit layout, Vegas; long straights,” the Italian commented. “We know – we have seen this in Monza, we have seen this in Baku – that when the requirement is to develop top speed, not necessarily McLaren is the best car. We know that this also somehow relates to our [shorter] gear ratios that are not ideal when you need to go above a certain level of top speed.

“But having said that, we approach Vegas with some optimism because the car is faster now. This race will give us – and not [just] us but everyone, I think – a bit of understanding of how to use the tyres and where the car is good, where their car or our car is less good. So there's information to be capitalised for Vegas as well.

“So we look with some optimism. Also, Vegas, we want to go there and have a good result, because it's been probably, of all the races in the calendar, the one that we've been struggling the most. And even last year that we had a good race, we made our life bad with the problem that we had with the skid. We look forward to Vegas, have a good result there and finally be in peace with this venue.”

items.titleZh: F1委员会将讨论针对车队的ADUO计划
items.summaryZh: F1委员会将讨论一项针对车队的ADUO计划，旨在帮助车队摆脱成本上限的困境。
items.originalTitle: 'ADUO for teams' plan to be discussed by F1
detailZh: 对成本上限规则的全面改革似乎将成为周一在一级方程式委员会上讨论的关键议题，届时将辩论一项针对各队的“ADUO提案”。
正如《赛车》杂志首次报道的那样，威廉姆斯车队老板詹姆斯·沃尔斯提出了一个支出追赶机制的构想，以帮助一级方程式车队摆脱他认为已经成为‘成本上限陷阱’的困境。
沃尔斯认为，虽然成本上限规则在使所有车队在经济上具有可行性方面做得很好，但它也固化了既有的优势，这使得小车队难以赶上大型车队。
他正在推动在成本上限内实施一个滑动比例追赶系统，允许排名前四名之外的车队花费更多。
这意味着那些排名最后的车队将获得更大的财务自由，以帮助他们缩小与领先车队之间的差距。
Vowles的提议已被添加到下周F1委员会会议的议程中，正式命名为“ADUO for teams”。
这是指额外发展和升级机会，它存在于发动机制造商中 - 如果他们的动力单元低于基准，他们将获得额外的支出津贴、动力测试小时和认证机会。
Vowles最初希望为该计划获得足够的支持，以便它能够在明年尽早通过F1委员会并纳入规则手册。
为了实现这一点，需要国际汽联（FIA）、自由媒体公司（FOM）以及当前11支车队中的6支车队支持，这被称为超级多数支持。
但来自其他五支车队的支持似乎不太可能，目前只有凯迪拉克、阿尔派恩、阿斯顿·马丁和奥迪表示支持。
哈斯车队反对这一提议，因为它距离当前的成本上限还有一段距离，因此在支出上没有限制，而青训车队老板艾伦·帕尔曼表示他不支持这一概念。
然而，车队的分歧意见并不意味着这个想法已经死亡，因为总共四支车队的支持就足以让这个想法在2028年得以实施。
这将是足够早的，以便它能够帮助塑造2030年或2031年即将开始的下一个规则时代的形势。
沃尔斯最近表示，一个折中的解决方案仍然是可能的——特别是如果国际汽联和F1支持他的计划的话——但实施可能不会迅速。
“也许对我来说更重要的是，我有国际汽联和一级方程式的支持，”他说。
“我认为我们还没有一个足够准确的指导方向，我们需要采取的是正确的，对这项运动有益的方向，这仍然在幕后讨论中。”
“我能说的是，支持是存在的。”
““我认为这不会一夜之间发生。正如我之前提到的，我想要确保的是，我们在下一次规则变更之前把它做好，这个时间点还比较远，所以我们有足够的时间。”"
““但我的怀疑是，在接下来的几个月里，你将看到越来越多的讨论。”"
““但Vowles的想法并不是唯一受到关注的成本上限变化，因为这些讨论似乎将引发关于更广泛改革的争论。”"
F1的顶级车队从“ADUO车队”这一想法中获益甚少，因为最大的受益者将是那些希望关闭这些车队的车队。
但这并不意味着大型车队对当前成本上限规则的工作方式感到满意，因为他们也在寻求对规则的改变——以帮助F1保持竞争力。
其中最热门的话题之一是当前成本上限如何影响员工保留以及F1整体保持最优秀工程师的能力。
在成本上限下运营的车队被迫控制薪资，这导致许多F1车队在与那些被科技公司高薪吸引的才华横溢的人员争夺中处于劣势。
也有许多关于员工在其他赛车系列（除了F1）中能够赚取更多收入的例子，因为成本上限已经对工资设定了上限。
在全球生活成本危机的背景下，这个问题的重要性日益增加，因为F1的成本上限与通货膨胀紧密相连，所以车队无法提高工资以满足员工的需求。
现在正在逐渐形成的一个强有力的论点是，成本上限应该演变并区分零部件支出和人员支出。
正如F1规则长期以来所做的那样，只有组织内部薪酬最高的三名人员可以免除包含在成本上限内。
过去曾讨论过将人数扩展到最多300人，但人们认为这会是一个过于宽泛的范围，实际上会使成本上限失效。
在上周末的巴西大奖赛上，梅赛德斯车队老板托托·沃尔夫表示，他的车队早已提出了一个缓解机制——但这一提议被否决了。
他对天空体育说：“我本希望得到一点提升。我们提出的想法是，随着更多青训车队人员加入车队，我们将有更多的资金来支付他们更好的薪水，而不是在最初的五到七年内压低薪水。
“因此，我们向国际汽联提出了一个请求，希望给予我们一些补贴，不是更多的前翼补贴，而是希望薪水能稍微提高一些，因为成本上限压制了所有这些。但显然这并没有赢得很多好评。”
detailEn: Sweeping changes to cost cap rules look set to become a key area of discussion on Monday when an “ADUO for teams” proposal is debated at the Formula 1 Commission.
As first revealed by The Race, Williams team boss James Vowles has tabled the idea of a spending catch-up mechanism to help F1 teams escape what he thinks has become a “cost cap trap”.

Vowles argues that while the cost cap has done a great job making all teams financially viable, it has also locked in legacy advantages that make it difficult for smaller teams to catch up with the bigger squads.
He is pushing for a sliding scale catch-up system within the cost cap that allows the teams outside of the top four to spend more.
It would mean those teams that finish bottom of the standings get greater financial freedom to help them close the gap to squads at the front.
Vowles’ proposal has been added to the agenda of next week’s F1 Commission meeting, with it becoming formally known as “ADUO for teams”.

This is in reference to the ADUO (Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities) that exists for engine manufacturers - who are given extra spending allowances, dyno hours and homologation opportunities if their power unit is adrift of the benchmark.
Vowles had originally hoped to get enough backing for the plan for it to get voted through the F1 Commission and into the rulebook as early as next year.
For that to happen, it would have required support from the FIA, FOM plus six of the current 11 teams for what is known as a supermajority.
But backing from five others appears unlikely, with only Cadillac, Alpine, Aston Martin and Audi supportive so far.
Haas is against because it is not near the current cost cap limit so is not limited on spending, while Racing Bulls team boss Alan Permane has said he does not back the concept.
The divided opinion in the paddock does not mean that the idea is dead, though, as support from four teams in total would be enough to get it into play for 2028.
That would be early enough for it to then help shape things for the next rules era that is due to start in 2030 or 2031.
Vowles said recently that a compromise solution remained possible - especially with support from the FIA and F1 over his plans - but implementation may not be swift.
“What's more important to me, perhaps, is I have the support of the FIA and Formula 1 behind it,” he said.
“I don't think we have an accurate enough direction that we need to take it in, that is right for the sport, which is still being discussed behind the scenes.
“What I can say is the support is there.

“I don't think it's going to happen overnight. As I previously mentioned, what I want to make sure is that we get it right by the next regulation change, which is a little way off, so we have some time.
“But my suspicion on it is you'll see more and more being discussed over the next few months in that regard.”
But Vowles’ idea is not the only cost cap change that is under the spotlight, because these discussions look set to trigger arguments about wider reform.
F1’s top teams have little to gain from the idea of an “ADUO for teams”, as the biggest beneficiaries would be those squads hoping to close them down.
But that does not mean the big squads are satisfied with how the current cost cap rules work, as they too are seeking changes to the regulations - to help F1 stay competitive.
One of the hottest topics among them is the way that current cost cap limits are impacting the retention of staff and the ability of F1 as a whole to keep hold of the brightest engineers.

Teams operating under the cost cap are forced to keep a lid on salaries, and that has left many F1 teams fighting a losing battle to retain talented personnel who are getting lured away by big-money offers from tech companies.
There are also many stories of staff being able to earn better money in other racing series outside of F1 because the cost cap has put a ceiling on wages so much.
The issue has increased in importance amid a global cost-of-living crisis, with F1’s cost cap increase tightly linked to inflation so teams are unable to lift salaries to respond to what staff need.
A strong argument that is now gathering some pace is for the cost cap to evolve and separate spending on parts and spending on people.
As has long been the case with F1’s rules, only the three highest-paid personnel within an organisation are exempt from being included within the cost cap.
There were discussions in the past about expanding this to include up to 300 staff, but it is thought that this would be too wide a net and would effectively make the cost cap ineffective.
Speaking at the Brazilian Grand Prix last weekend, Mercedes boss Toto Wolff said that his squad had long proposed a mitigating mechanism - but this was shot down.

He told Sky F1: “I would have loved to have a little bit of an uplift. The idea that we had was that with more junior personnel that joined the team, we would have more allowance to pay them better and not [having] the salaries suppressed in the first five, six, seven years.

“So we've pitched that to the FIA to give us an allowance, not for more front wings but an allowance for salaries to come up a little bit because the cost cap suppresses all of that. But obviously that didn't score a lot of brownie points.”
keyPointsZh: 威廉姆斯车队老板詹姆斯·沃尔斯提出了一项新的成本追赶机制。
沃尔斯认为成本上限虽然使所有车队在经济上可行，但也固化了传统优势，使小车队难以追赶大车队。
该计划旨在让排名靠后的车队获得更多财务自由，以缩小与领先车队的差距。
keyPointsEn: James Vowles has proposed a new spending catch-up mechanism.
Vowles believes that the cost cap has done a great job making all teams financially viable, but it has also locked in legacy advantages.
The plan aims to give teams at the bottom of the standings greater financial freedom to close the gap to the front-runners.

detailZh: 詹姆斯·阿隆索揭秘基米·安东内利F1世界冠军背后的冒险技巧
詹姆斯·阿隆索说安东内利在锦标赛赛季中从刹车到弯顶的控制给人留下深刻印象
梅赛德斯为粉丝提供最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析
梅赛德斯技术总监詹姆斯·阿隆索解释了基米·安东内利如何通过大胆使用方向盘上的工具帮助他成为F1最年轻的世界冠军。
意大利车手在20岁时就赢得了2026年的冠军，这是他在F1的第二赛季，今年已经赢得了九场大奖赛。
在天空体育银箭电台节目中，艾莉森表示安东内利在如何使用刹车迁移方面非常非常灵活，这种技术会改变车辆在转弯时前后刹车力的分配，以及差速器的工作方式。
他非常非常敢于冒险：如果他的车在转向时出现他不喜欢的转向不足，他会通过差速器和刹车迁移来释放它，即使它并不特别想转向。相反，当它感觉过于活跃时，他会关闭它，使其不那么活跃。
现在，每个人都会这样做，但基米在这方面非常敢于冒险。他愿意在极端设置上尝试，并依靠自己的力量去做，相信他能够控制车辆，使其指向弯道的顶点。这已经是他今年从车辆中获得速度的一大原因。
“从他踩下刹车到进入弯道的极限，大部分时间他都在控制圈速，而且他做得非常轻松。这使得他在不同条件下对车辆的控制非常灵活，观看他的表现真的非常令人印象深刻。”
“这种进入弯道的速度也使得安东内利能够更好地照顾他的轮胎。”
“如果你想看到基米今年最出色的表现，那就是在其他人已经进站换胎的时候，他的圈速依然保持稳定，”他补充道。“他一遍又一遍地做到这一点，而且由于他在进站时的所有工作，他并没有因为工作而损坏后胎。”
“艾莉森还透露了安东内利和他的赛车工程师彼得‘Bono’博宁顿之间的信任程度，说这位车手会直接告诉他：‘好吧，我信任你。你认为怎么做就怎么做，我会尽力利用我所得到的一切。’”
“波诺可能会告诉你，这是他经历过的最愉快的赛季之一，”艾莉森总结道。
detailEn: James Allison reveals the "very adventurous" trick behind Kimi Antonelli's F1 title
James Allison says Antonelli’s control from braking to the apex has been impressive throughout his championship season
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Mercedes technical director James Allison has explained how Kimi Antonelli's bold use of the tools on his steering wheel helped him become Formula 1's youngest world champion.
The Italian driver secured the 2026 title at the Mexican Grand Prix at the age of 20, in only his second season in F1, and has won nine grands prix so far this year.

Speaking on the NU Silver Arrows Radio Show, Allison said Antonelli was "very, very agile" in how he uses brake migration, which changes how the braking force is shared between the front and rear of the car as a corner unfolds, and the differential.

"He is very, very adventurous: if he has a car that's understeering in a way that he doesn't like, he will free it up with the diff and the brake migration to allow it to turn even if it doesn't particularly want to. And the contrary, when it feels too lively, he will close it down so that it is less so," Allison explained.

"Now, everyone does this, but Kimi is very adventurous with it. He's willing to go to quite extreme settings on it and do it under his own steam, trusting that he will have the control to keep the car pointed nicely to the apex. And that has been a large part of the pace that he has got from the car this year.

"From the moment he hits the brakes to the apex is mostly where he is taking the lap time, and he does all that with a minimum of fuss. It makes him very flexible with the car from condition to condition, and it's been really impressive to watch."
That speed into the corner also allows Antonelli to look after his tyres.

"If you want to see the standout performances of Kimi this year, it's 20 laps in when everyone else has peeled into the pits and his lap times just go level," he added. "He does it over and over and over, and he just does not damage the rear tyres because of all the work he's doing on the entry."

Allison also revealed the level of trust between Antonelli and his race engineer, Peter 'Bono' Bonnington, saying the driver will simply tell him: "Well, I trust you. You do what you think is right, and I'll try and work with what I get."
"Bono would probably tell you that it's been one of the most pleasurable seasons he's had," Allison concluded.

detailZh: 格恩特·施泰纳表示马克·韦伯可能过于介入奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂的职业生涯
前哈斯车队负责人认为奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在2025年下半年艰难的时期后希望获得更大的独立性
对于麦凯轮车队的粉丝来说，来自沃金克的最新消息，包括车手、赛车、团队策略以及每个周末的比赛情况
前哈斯一级方程式车队负责人格恩特·施泰纳认为，在马克·韦伯决定‘我要自己来做这件事’之前，他可能在2025年下半年过于介入了奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂的职业生涯。
皮亚斯特里和Webber在圣保罗大奖赛之后宣布，他们已经相互同意结束自2019年开始的管理协议，在这期间澳大利亚人从三级方程式和二级方程式一路晋升至麦凯轮的赛车席位。
Webber今年已经缩减了自己的角色，并且不再与皮亚斯特里一同参加比赛。
在《红旗播客》上，Steiner表示这个消息并不让他感到惊讶。
“实际上我并不太惊讶，因为正如你所说，Mark并不在身边。今年我可能见过Mark一两次，不多。他没有在身边。而且很明显，他在年初就说过了，他不会再像以前那样陪伴Oscar了。”
Steiner随后指向了2025年的后半部分，当时皮亚斯特里对迈凯伦车队队友诺里斯的冠军挑战逐渐减弱，这是关系开始改变的时刻。
去年赛季的后半段，当奥斯卡没有赢得世界冠军时，也许马克也介入得有点过多。然后在某个阶段，奥斯卡说，'好吧，我现在更有经验了。我想自己来做这件事。'
Steiner表示，后退并不是Webber的天然选择。
一开始，你说，'嘿，让我们少参与一些。'但马克不是那种坐在人行道上看着我们表现不佳的人。显然，奥斯卡可能想与马克切断联系，但他欠他很多。在我看来，他的一些成功要归功于Mark Webber。
在2026赛季还剩三轮的情况下，皮亚斯特里目前以152分位列车手积分榜第七位。
detailEn: Guenther Steiner suggests Mark Webber became too involved in Oscar Piastri’s career
The former Haas team principal believes Oscar Piastri wanted greater independence after a difficult second half of 2025
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.

Former Haas Formula 1 team principal Guenther Steiner believes Mark Webber may have become too involved in Oscar Piastri’s career in the second half of 2025, before the McLaren driver decided he wanted to “do this on my own”.

Piastri and Webber announced after the São Paulo Grand Prix that they had mutually agreed to end their management agreement, which began in 2019 and saw the Australian rise through Formula 3 and Formula 2 to a McLaren race seat.
Webber had already scaled back his role this year and stopped attending races alongside Piastri.
Speaking on The Red Flags Podcast, Steiner said the news did not come as a shock.

“I’m actually not too surprised because, as you said, Mark was not around. I’ve seen Mark this year maybe once or twice, not more,” Steiner said. “He was not around. And obviously, he said at the beginning of the year that he would not be beside Oscar anymore as he was in the good old days.”
Steiner then pointed to the latter part of 2025, when Piastri’s title challenge against his McLaren team-mate Lando Norris faded, as the moment the relationship began to change.

“The second half of the season last year, when Oscar, after he didn’t win the world championship, maybe Mark got a little bit involved too much. And then at some stage, Oscar said, ‘OK, I’m now more experienced. I want to do this on my own.’”
Steiner suggested that stepping back did not come naturally to Webber.

“In the beginning, you say, ‘Hey, let’s be less around.’ But Mark is not the guy who is like, ‘OK, I’m just sitting on the sidewalk seeing how we are not performing.’ And then, obviously, Oscar maybe wants to cut the ties with Mark, but he owes him a lot. Some of his success is owed to Mark Webber, in my opinion.”
With three rounds remaining in the 2026 season, Piastri currently sits seventh in the drivers' championship with 152 points.

items.originalTitle: “I was getting beat up” – How Daniel Ricciardo burned out on ‘humiliating’ F1 return
items.summaryEn: Speaking on the Beyond The Grid podcast, Daniel Ricciardo reflected on the final years of his career, saying his time at McLaren and his return to the Faenza-based team left him frustrated and damaged his mental health.
detailZh: “我被打得遍体鳞伤”——里卡多如何在“令人羞辱”的F1回归中耗尽心力
里卡多离开F1两年后，他敞开心扉谈论职业生涯的终结——这段经历不仅令人沮丧，也伤害了他的心理健康
上个月，丹尼尔·里卡多做客Beyond The Grid播客时，听起来更加沉稳，甚至多了几分睿智。远离F1聚光灯的两年，给了这位澳大利亚人反思所需的时间，让他得以从新的角度审视自己在锦标赛中的最后几年。
最后几年是一段挣扎。失去迈凯伦席位后，里卡多回到了他昔日的法恩扎车队，希望借此重返红牛——但未能如愿。他再也找不回久违的表现，而此前在沃金他已经历了一段备受打击的时光。他在意大利大奖赛上的惊人胜利，也难以掩盖一个事实：除此之外，他在最后70场比赛中再未登上领奖台。
虽然他的F1之旅并未按照他自己的意愿结束——红牛决定让年轻车手利亚姆·劳森获得小红牛车队的第二个席位——但里卡多已经意识到，甚至说服自己，他还没有准备好退役，他已经不再处于适合比赛的心态之中。
“到那个时候，我已经受够了被击倒；我想，我已经被打得遍体鳞伤，”他在谈到自己最后一场比赛——2024年新加坡大奖赛——时的心态说道。
“我仍然充满渴望，想要证明些什么——主要是向我自己证明——但有些时刻我已经受够了，而且我认为自己也在否认，又回到了我们有时会竖起的那层保护壳：‘我能做到，我很坚强，我会挺过去，我足够好，等等等等’。确实有些时候我会想，‘唉，我不再热爱这个了，我真的不想待在这里’。睡一觉就好了，睡一觉就好了，你会到达那里，你会没事的，然后也许有一场好比赛或一个瞬间你会觉得，‘是的，我又找回了那团火’。
“我当然仍然想要那个童话般的结局；我想要回到红牛车队，所有那些，我也很想再次成为马克斯的队友，再次尝试在前排竞争。但我内心深处知道，这一切让我越来越疲惫。我认为，由于很多因素，对我来说，再像以前那样表现和竞争已经不再那么容易了。你看到有些车手年纪比我大，仍然在高水平上做到这一点，所以每个人情况都不同。”
“有太多的痛苦、过程，太多这些年正在发生和已经发生的事情，我觉得它们只是不断累积，而我很难把这一切都关在外面然后继续去做。”
被情绪淹没的里卡多不确定自己能否做出那个可以说是健康的决定——自己主动叫停。
“我当时的恐惧是，事后回想并体会到不再拥有那份合同让我多么满足，如果他们一直给我续约，我会不会一直做下去，我到底会不会关掉这个水龙头？我知道我有时是想关掉的，”他承认道。“我现在可以告诉你，2022年摩纳哥站赛后，我坐在公寓里，和我的团队交谈，我当时就说，‘我不想再这样下去了，我受够了’。这些年来我不止一次有过这样的对话——2015年银石是另一次。”
里卡多在2022年摩纳哥大奖赛代表迈凯伦仅排位第14、正赛第13完赛，而这条赛道正是他四年前夺冠的地方。在2015年英国大奖赛上，他因超出赛道限制被取消第九快的时间后仅列第10位发车，起步时与罗曼·格罗斯让相撞，在后方车阵中挣扎，直到遭遇电气故障。
“你身边的人会对你说，‘你很棒，你还能做到’，最终你也会相信很多这样的声音——我知道他们没有恶意，但你其实没有太多机会拥有自己的想法，我觉得这种情况可能还会继续下去，也许我现在还在比赛——这也是一个可怕的想法，”这位37岁的车手补充道。
“我仍然不喜欢它结束的方式，但我内心也有一部分感激他们扣动了扳机，因为我不想现在还在做这件事。”
尽管如此，里卡多仍在与自己所说的失败感和羞辱感作斗争，因为他的职业生涯戛然而止，他为自己的世界冠军梦想而哀悼。
“你在这么小的年纪就开始比赛，多年来你建立起了一种，我想，冷酷——但那也是向内的，”他解释道。“你可能会对自己非常严厉，对自己期望很高。所以我认为，比如说，失败——那是我对它的看法，失败，没有达到我当时需要的水平，或者无法完成赛季，或者不管什么——那之后就是一种羞辱感。我失败了，我没有做到我曾经能做到的事。
“在应对那一切、接下来的几个月里，我明白自己只是在逃避那份羞辱感。人们看到我在公共场合，我表现得‘哈哈哈，我玩得很开心’，喝点酒什么的，而我其实只是在逃避内心深处真实的感受，那是大量的痛苦和悲伤。‘一切都过去了。我曾经是那个渴望争夺世界冠军、赢得比赛的孩子；一切都过去了。’”
于是里卡多退后一步，远离了F1围场和相关的媒体事务，优先留出他需要的独处时间。
“就驾驶而言，我已经精疲力竭，更不用说情绪之类的了，我只是累了，”他说。“我只知道我需要远离一切——甚至远离人群。去年我做了很多独自旅行和出游，很多徒步之类的活动。我只知道我需要独自呼吸。”
但这位八次大奖赛冠军得主去年五月确实出席了印第安纳波利斯500大赛，这重新点燃了他对赛车的热情。
“重新做回车迷让我想起，我确实热爱赛车运动。”
detailEn: “I was getting beat up” – How Daniel Ricciardo burned out on ‘humiliating’ F1 return
Two years on from Ricciardo’s F1 exit, he opens up about the end of his career – which was not only frustrating but damaging to his mental health too

As Daniel Ricciardo joined the Beyond The Grid podcast last month, he sounded more grounded, almost wiser. Two years away from Formula 1’s limelight have provided the Australian with the time he required for introspection, allowing him to view his final years in the championship from a new angle.

Those final years were a struggle. After losing his McLaren seat, Ricciardo returned to his old Faenza team with a view to make a Red Bull comeback – to no avail. He never found his long-lost performance again, having previously experienced a bruising time in Woking. His shock Italian Grand Prix victory hardly distracts from the fact that, other than that, he never finished on the podium in his final 70 races.

While his F1 adventure did not wind up on his own terms – with Red Bull deciding that youngster Liam Lawson was the way to go for the second RB seat – Ricciardo has grown aware, even persuading himself that he wasn’t ready to retire, that he no longer was in the right state of mind for racing.
“By that point, I was done getting knocked down; I was, I guess, getting beat up,” he said of his state of mind at his last race, the 2024 Singapore GP.

“I was still hungry and wanting to try to prove something – mainly to myself – but there were moments where I was done, and I think also in denial, back to that protective shield that we may put up at times: ‘I can do this, I’m strong, I’ll get through this, I’m good enough, blah blah blah’. There were definitely times that I was like, ‘Ugh, I don’t love this anymore, I don’t really want to be here’. Sleep it off, sleep it off, you’ll get there and you’ll be fine and then maybe have one good race or one moment you’re like, ‘Yeah, I’ve got the fire back’.

“I still wanted the fairy tale, of course; I wanted to get back with Red Bull Racing and all of that, and I would have loved to have been team-mates with Max again and tried to race at the front again. But I knew deep down I was getting more burned out by it all. I think, because of a lot of factors, it wasn’t as easy for me anymore to perform and compete at the level that I once did. And you see some guys that are still doing it at a high level, that are older than me, so it’s different for everyone.

“There was just a lot of pain, process, a lot of things that just were happening and had happened over the years, that I think just built up, and it was just very hard for me to shut all that out and do it.”
Overwhelmed by his emotions, Ricciardo isn’t certain he could have made the arguably healthy decision to pull the plug himself.

“The fear I had is, in hindsight and learning how content I am not having that anymore, what if they kept extending contracts for me, would I keep doing it, was I ever going to turn the tap off? I know I wanted to at times,” he admitted. “I can tell you right now, Monaco 2022 after the race, I’m sitting in my apartment, talking to my team, and I was like, ‘I don’t want to do this anymore, I’m done’. I’ve had this conversation more than once over the years – Silverstone 2015 was another time.”

Ricciardo qualified a lowly 14th and finished 13th in the 2022 Monaco GP with McLaren, at the track where he had won four years prior. In the 2015 British GP, he was just 10th on the grid after his ninth-fastest time was deleted for a track-limits infringement, collided with Romain Grosjean at the start, and struggled in the lower pack until he was struck by an electrical failure.

“You have people around you that tell you, ‘You’re great, you can still do it’, and you end up also believing a lot of these voices – I know they don’t mean harm, but you don’t really get a chance to have your own thoughts much, and I think that would have probably just continued and maybe I would still be racing – and that’s also a scary thought,” the 37-year-old added.
“I still don’t like how it ended, but there’s also a part of me which is grateful they pulled the trigger, because I wouldn’t want to be doing it now.”
Still, Ricciardo struggled with what he described as a sense of failure and humiliation as his career ended abruptly and he mourned his dream of a world title.

“You start racing at such a young age, and over the years you build, I guess, a ruthlessness – but that also is inward as well,” he explained. “You can be very harsh on yourself and expect a lot from yourself. So I think, let’s say, failing – that was my view of it, failing, not performing to the level I needed to at the time, or not being able to finish out the season, or whatever – it’s then a sense of humiliation. I failed, and I didn’t do what I once could.

“Trying to deal with that, those next few months, I understood it as I was just hiding from the humiliation. People saw me out in public, I was, ‘Ha ha ha, I’m having a good time’, having a drink or whatever, and I was just hiding from what I really felt deep inside, which was a lot of pain and sadness. ‘It’s gone. I was once this kid that was hoping to fight for a world title and winning races; it’s gone’.”
So Ricciardo took a step back, stayed away from the Formula 1 paddock and the associated media commitments, and prioritised the alone time he needed.

“In terms of driving, I was burned out, let alone emotions and all that, I was just tired,” he said. “I just knew I needed time from everything – even people. I did a lot of solo travelling and trips last year, a lot of hiking and things. I just know that I needed to breathe on my own.”
But the eight-time grand prix winner did attend the Indianapolis 500 last May, which reignited his passion for racing.
“Being a fan again reminded me that I do love motorsports.”

detailZh: 达蒙·希尔：法拉利存在‘政治问题’，刘易斯·汉密尔顿‘重塑了自己’
达蒙·希尔敦促法拉利支持‘重塑’的刘易斯·汉密尔顿，解决内部政治问题，为2027年的冠军而战
法拉利车迷们。最新的法拉利F1新闻，车手更新，技术分析和来自马拉内洛及以外的比赛反应。
法拉利车队负责人弗雷德·瓦瑟尔最近坚持表示，刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔在巴西的一次私人会议后‘开怀大笑’离开了我的房间，以澄清气氛。但1996年一级方程式冠军达蒙·希尔并不相信马拉内洛突然的和谐。
根据希尔的说法，斯库德里亚正在积极掩盖分歧。分析最近的三站赛果，希尔指出法拉利幕后存在着日益扩大的分歧。他认为，而不是作为一个统一的战线工作，车队正在分裂其忠诚度。
“我们需要在车队内部解决这个问题，因为那个车队里有一个政治问题，”希尔在接受天空体育F1采访时表示。“对我来说，看起来车队内部有派系在为某一侧或另一侧而战。”
这种摩擦正在汉密尔顿回归2026年赛车获胜状态的过程中加剧。当这位七届冠军最初与意大利车队签约时，怀疑者质疑了他的动机，因为他经历了多年的无竞争力赛车和2021年锦标赛决赛的持续创伤。
希尔强调了这一确切的心理历程，承认这次失败对英国车手的打击有多深，以及他目前的复兴。
“自从2021年阿布扎比以来，他一直处于低谷，”希尔观察到。
汉密尔顿并没有把加盟法拉利的决定当作退休巡游，而是利用这个环境的变化来完全重置他的竞技状态。
“他今年表现得非常出色，比我预想的要好得多，因为我认为这将非常困难，但他已经重塑了自己，”希尔总结道。
detailEn: Damon Hill: Ferrari has a “political problem” as Lewis Hamilton “rebuilt himself”
Damon Hill urges Ferrari to back a "rebuilt" Lewis Hamilton and solve their internal political issues for a 2027 title run
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.

Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur recently insisted that Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc "left my room joking together" following a private meeting in Brazil to clear the air. But 1996 Formula 1 champion Damon Hill is not buying the sudden harmony at Maranello.

According to Hill, the Scuderia is actively masking a rift. Analysing the fallout from the recent triple-header, Hill pointed to a growing divide behind the scenes at Ferrari. He believes that, rather than working as a unified front, the team is splitting its loyalties.

"We need to settle this in the team because there's a political problem in that team," Hill stated, speaking with Sky Sports F1. "For me, it seems like there's factions within the team that are shooting for one side or the other."

This friction is being catalysed by Hamilton's return to his race-winning form in 2026. When the seven-time champion initially signed with the Italian outfit, sceptics questioned his motivation after he had endured years of uncompetitive machinery and lingering trauma from the 2021 championship decider.
Hill highlighted that exact psychological journey, acknowledging how deeply the loss impacted the British driver before his current revival.
"He's been crushed since Abu Dhabi, in effect, in 2021," Hill observed.
Instead of treating his move to Ferrari as a retirement tour, Hamilton has used the change of scenery to completely reset his competitive edge.
"He's performed incredibly well this year, much better than I thought, considering I thought it was going to be very difficult, but he's rebuilt himself," Hill concluded.

detailZh: 拉斯维加斯大奖赛揭晓灵感源自霓虹灯牌的奖杯设计
拉斯维加斯大奖赛为下周的F1赛事准备了新的奖杯
拉斯维加斯大奖赛公布了下周F1赛事的新奖杯设计，灵感来源于城市及其霓虹灯。
这个3.6公斤重，56厘米高的获胜者奖杯历时六个月开发制作，并模仿了拉斯维加斯大道上标志性的霓虹灯牌，该赛道就是围绕这些霓虹灯牌建造的。
奖杯内有122个灯，为获胜者带来了独特的‘看到你的名字在灯光中’的意义，这是内华达市独有的设计。
它还特别采用了V字形的轮廓，灯泡汇聚于V字的尖端，类似于拉斯维加斯的老式帐篷如何将注意力引向城市弗里蒙特街上的著名表演者名字，使其闻名。
赛车组织者再次与鲍恩工作室和奥雷设计公司合作——他们曾设计了2023-25年拉斯维加斯大奖赛的奖杯——在开发成品之前，使用了3D模型和渲染。
拉斯维加斯大奖赛将于11月19日至21日举行，在F1赛季结束前，接下来的周末将进行卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛轮次。
detailEn: Las Vegas GP reveals neon sign-inspired trophy design
Las Vegas GP has new trophies for next weekend’s F1 round
The Las Vegas Grand Prix has unveiled a new trophy design for next weekend’s Formula 1 round, inspired by the city and its neon lights.
The 3.6kg, 56cm-tall winners’ trophy took six months to develop and build and emulates the neon signs synonymous with the Las Vegas strip that the circuit is based around.
The trophy contains 122 lights puts a new meaning to ‘seeing your name in lights’ for the winner in a design unique to the Nevada city.

It also features a distinctive V-shaped silhouette, with the bulbs converging toward the point of the V, similar to the way vintage marquees in Las Vegas directed attention toward the featured performer's name made famous on the city’s Freemont Street.
Race organisers teamed up with Bowen Studios and Ore Designs again – having designed the 2023-25 Las Vegas GP trophies – using a 3D model and rendering before developing the finished product.
The Las Vegas GP takes place on 19-21 November before the F1 season concludes with the Qatar and Abu Dhabi rounds on the subsequent weekends.
